semantics.unusedInnerLayers: inner copper layers on which the pad is hidden

installed_schema.comment: 隐藏焊盘层（可选）：被隐藏焊盘的层数组

public_primitive_api.conclusion: Use the native PAD body field in a full FOOTPRINT source; the current public primitive wrapper has no unusedInnerLayers setter. specialPad is not a substitute for hiding an inner layer.

source_copper_coverage.method: All extracted dark conductor flashes, stroked line/arc tracks, and additive region contours were tested at each drill centre. Gerber copper represents a drilled PTH pad as solid copper at the centre; the Excellon drill is applied separately. Therefore no dark copper at the centre is stronger evidence than component-pad-flash absence alone.

candidate_scope.withheld_reason: U5/U7 exposed-pad drilled features are not included. The comprehensive raw Gerber scan found a same-net GND circular flash at each centre on all four inner layers, contradicting the component-footprint absent-flash heuristic. Their inner annuli must therefore be preserved pending a separate review.

application_gates: Do not apply through the public primitive wrapper; it has no unusedInnerLayers setter.
Use each full checkpoint-derived FOOTPRINT source and preserve every non-target record.
Verify project/name guard and create a recoverable checkpoint before any library write.
After applying, clear/reload footprint and PCB caches before judging instantiated pads.
Export a new full checkpoint and prove only the 32 PAD arrays changed.
Run native DRC: the 74 connector Fill Region-to-TH Pad zero-clearance errors should disappear, while hole clearance checks must remain active.
Do not infer manufacturing approval; all remaining clearance/connection errors still block release.
